title: Close-up of a smartwatch on wrist; screen lights up showing notifications and…
content: Close-up of a smartwatch on wrist; screen lights up showing notifications and real-time heart rate. Smooth lighting, realistic, high quality. Voiceover: "Meet the smartwatch that keeps up with your lifestyle. Track your health, workouts, and daily activity with ease." 10-second video.
